title: CSOAI Designed 33-Agent Council — Sovereign Governance

text: CSOAI Designed 33-Agent Council — Sovereign Governance EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → ⚠ EU AI Act Article 50 watermarking cliff — -- d : -- h : -- m : -- s | Sovereign-by-construction · SIGIL + council + OWEM · cliff 2 Aug 2026 00:00 CEST Home Master DESIGNED 33-AGENT COUNCIL · THRESHOLD 23/33 · ED25519-SIGNED The council that ratifies every sovereign action. Retraction, 2026-07-29 (DR-0007). CSOAI previously described this council as tolerating Byzantine faults. We measured the effective independence of its legs rather than assuming it: n_eff came out at 1.21 against 3 nominal legs . The legs are correlated, so a threshold over them does not deliver the guarantee the threshold implies. The claim is withdrawn. What remains is a designed 33-agent council with an Ed25519-signed action log. The consensus property is not claimed. 41 agents, 4 tiers, one vote. Every CSOAI charter, framework, and cross-walk is approved by at least 23 of 33 voting agents before it ships. 🛡 Threshold 23/33 · Article 0 binding · Ed25519-signed · OTS-anchored 41 Council members 23/33 Threshold required 4 Tiers 100% Receipt coverage ∞ Vote cycles Executive tier L4 · 1 member L4-001 APPROVE CS Care Sentinel Care & Safety Lead Tier L4 · Executive "No action without care floor.
